Detailed Description

template<typename T>
class SoundProcessor< T >

Base class for all the processors.

Provides a common interface for the child objects, defining the general sampling rate and the virtual function process ().

template<typename T>
virtual T& SoundProcessor< T >::process ( T &  sig  )  [pure virtual]

Pure virtual method that every child class MUST implement.

The output of this function should be the sample value specific to each class, while the input must be another sample.

Implemented in AdaptiveEstimator, BiQuad, CorrelationEstimator, DCBlocker, EnvelopeFollower, Exponator, PeriodEstimator, Renoise, SpectralEstimator, Tone, VariState, WaveletEstimator, and ZeroCrossings.
